title: Deepfake robustness
description: I test what happens to face-manipulation detectors after JPEG compression, resizing and blur, using source-video splits and uncertainty estimates.
alt: Illustration of a face crop passing through compression, resize and blur checks

title: Where was this photo taken?
description: A single RegNet model predicts locations across 12 European countries. It combines country and region predictions with a local coordinate offset.
alt: Illustration connecting a street photograph to a location on a globe

title: Nürnberg, from above
description: I use Sentinel-2 imagery to estimate buildings, vegetation and water on a 100 m grid, then inspect how the city changes from 2019 to 2023.
alt: Conceptual land-cover grid with vegetation, buildings and a river

title: Learning an illustration style
description: A team project adapting Stable Diffusion 1.5 with LoRA on the UNet and text encoder. A custom token keeps style updates separate from the rest of the vocabulary.
alt: Actual LoRA-generated market scene from this project's sample output

title: A research assistant with tools
description: Questions go to the source that fits: an uploaded PDF, web search, arXiv or Wikipedia. The app makes that routing decision visible.
detail: PDF, web and academic source routing
alt: Question-routing illustration branching to documents, the web, arXiv and Wikipedia

title: Answers with page references
description: A PDF knowledge assistant that combines semantic and keyword search. Rank fusion selects the evidence, and answers include page-level citations.
alt: Illustration of semantic and keyword retrieval merging into a cited answer

title: Ask a SQLite database
description: Turns a question into SQL, validates it, and shows the query alongside its results. Read-only access and row limits sit between the model and the database.
alt: Illustration of a SELECT query passing a read-only guard before reaching SQLite

title: Long documents, shorter notes
description: Breaks PDFs, web pages and video transcripts into paragraph-sized chunks, summarizes each, then combines them into notes or a brief.
alt: Illustration of several document chunks being condensed into one summary

title: Math that checks its answer
description: SymPy solves the expression and checks the result by substitution. An optional language model explains the calculation after it has been verified.
alt: A worked equation with its solutions checked by substitution

title: A local coding workbench
description: Five separate workflows for explaining, debugging, testing, refactoring and reviewing code. Prompts run against CodeLlama through a local Ollama endpoint.
alt: Code-review illustration with local inference and distinct engineering task routes

title: Following a query stream
description: Replays Redshift query metrics through Kafka, validates and stores events in DuckDB, and exposes live and historical views in Streamlit.
alt: Illustration of query events flowing through Kafka into storage and analytics

title: Planning warehouse capacity
description: An offline tool for exported query metrics. It combines queue delay, spill events and concurrency into an explicit, adjustable pressure score.
detail: CSV input · no cloud connection needed
alt: Illustration of queue delay, spill and concurrency contributing to a capacity score

title: SpeechText
description: Records speech in the browser and transcribes it with Google Cloud. Transcript metadata goes to Firestore, with optional audio storage.
alt: Illustration of an audio waveform becoming a stored text transcript

title: From a dataset to a dashboard
description: Upload a file, inspect its schema, describe your analysis goal, then review suggested processing steps and charts in a React workspace.
alt: Concept illustration of a file upload, data table and chart workspace
